basis: closely related sleep-duration construct, with continuous overall duration explicitly treated as a sensitivity rather than an equivalent replacement for the long-sleep tail
larger effective sample size than the binary long-sleep contrast
European ancestry and GRCh37 compatibility with the frozen LAVA reference
publicly accessible, checksum-verifiable full summary statistics
selection_policy.candidate_definition: Self-reported hours of sleep in a 24-hour period, including naps, analyzed continuously
selection_policy.candidate_relation_to_canonical_longslee: Related construct; not equivalent. It includes the full duration distribution and is not restricted to >=9-hour cases versus 7-8-hour controls.

must_pass: source archive checksum matches acquired bytes and published source URL
harmonization retains valid effect, standard error, association statistic, coordinates, alleles, and sample size semantics
ancestry and genome build are compatible with the pinned European GRCh37 LAVA reference
reference overlap and variant support are sufficient under the frozen canonical minimum-K rules
univariate local-h2 computations use no pair context and the unchanged canonical LAVA implementation and eligibility gate
